connect.title: Connect Cloudy Canvas to your agents
connect.hint: Agents can read and edit the open board or design while you watch. Pick the one you use.
connect.description: Connect an AI agent to Cloudy Canvas.
connect.oneClick: Add it in one click, or set it up by hand.

manual.body: Any agent that speaks MCP can connect. Add a server named {name} with the {transport} transport, no authentication, at this URL. It only accepts connections from this computer.

clients.cursor: Paste into ~/.cursor/mcp.json, or .cursor/mcp.json in a project.
clients.vscode: Paste into .vscode/mcp.json in a project, for Copilot's agent mode.
clients.antigravity: Paste into the agent panel's ⋯ › MCP Servers › Manage MCP Servers › View raw config (~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json).
clients.claudeDesktop: Paste into Settings › Developer › Edit Config, then restart Claude. Needs Node.js.
clients.opencode: Merge into opencode.json (in a project or ~/.config/opencode/).
clients.generic: The usual mcpServers entry: .mcp.json, Cline and most other agents.
